verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The credential-bearing Authorization headers are moved from curl argv to curl's stdin header reader in all five changed call sites. The repository-wide guard fails closed on workflow parse failure and zero observed header arguments, reports only header names, and covers separated, joined-short, long-equals, case-insensitive, Proxy-Authorization, operator-boundary, synthetic leak/clean, and live-workflow directions. The live indirect-header anchor also prevents the three remediated workflow files from disappearing silently from observation. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect supported by the diff.
